meta.note: Second circle of verbs. Generated with adversarial pt-PT review.

cards.ex_t: Depois da levada vamos comer bolo do caco com manteiga de alho.
cards.ex_trans: After the levada walk we're going to eat bolo do caco with garlic butter.

cards.note: Portugal says beber for most drinks; Brazil prefers tomar.
cards.ex_t: Vamos beber uma poncha no fim do dia?
cards.ex_trans: Shall we drink a poncha at the end of the day?

cards.ex_t: Preciso de comprar fruta e legumes no Mercado dos Lavradores.
cards.ex_trans: I need to buy fruit and vegetables at the Mercado dos Lavradores.

cards.note: chegar a + place in Portugal (chegar ao Funchal); Brazil says chegar em.
cards.ex_t: O autocarro costuma chegar atrasado quando chove no Funchal.
cards.ex_trans: The bus usually arrives late when it rains in Funchal.

cards.ex_t: Hoje vou sair do trabalho mais cedo para ir à farmácia.
cards.ex_trans: Today I'm leaving work earlier to go to the pharmacy.

cards.ex_t: Preciso do código para entrar na garagem do condomínio.
cards.ex_trans: I need the code to get into the building's garage.

cards.note: voltar a + infinitive = to do something again.
cards.ex_t: Tenho de voltar à AIMA na quinta para levantar o cartão de residência.
cards.ex_trans: I have to go back to AIMA on Thursday to pick up my residence card.

cards.note: Irregular past participle: aberto.
cards.ex_t: A padaria só vai abrir às sete, ainda é cedo.
cards.ex_trans: The bakery only opens at seven, it's still early.

cards.ex_t: O supermercado vai fechar às nove; ainda dá tempo.
cards.ex_trans: The supermarket closes at nine; there's still time.

cards.note: Means both to wait and to hope/expect.
cards.ex_t: Detesto esperar pelo autocarro à chuva sem abrigo.
cards.ex_trans: I hate waiting for the bus in the rain with no shelter.

cards.note: False friend: to look for, not to procure.
cards.ex_t: Estou a procurar um T1 com varanda perto do Lido.
cards.ex_trans: I'm looking for a one-bedroom flat with a balcony near the Lido.

cards.note: Also to meet up: encontrar-se com alguém.
cards.ex_t: Não consigo encontrar o recibo da renda no meu email.
cards.ex_trans: I can't find the rent receipt in my email.

cards.note: Ask FOR something; asking a question is perguntar.
cards.ex_t: Ao balcão, vou pedir um galão e um pastel de nata.
cards.ex_trans: At the counter, I'll order a galão and a custard tart.

cards.note: Highly irregular; Brazil usually says colocar.
cards.ex_t: Vou pôr as compras no frigorífico antes que o peixe estrague.
cards.ex_trans: I'll put the shopping in the fridge before the fish goes off.

cards.note: Bring towards the speaker; taking away is levar.
cards.ex_t: Podes trazer pão e queijo quando vieres do mercado?
cards.ex_trans: Can you bring bread and cheese when you come from the market?

cards.note: Also to let: deixa-me ver = let me see.
cards.ex_t: Vou deixar a encomenda na portaria do condomínio.
cards.ex_trans: I'll leave the parcel at the building's front desk.

cards.note: começar a + infinitive: começar a trabalhar.
cards.ex_t: A reunião de equipa vai começar às nove em ponto.
cards.ex_trans: The team meeting starts at nine sharp.

cards.note: acabar de + infinitive = to have just done something.
cards.ex_t: Quero acabar este dashboard antes do almoço.
cards.ex_trans: I want to finish this dashboard before lunch.

cards.note: Also to wear: usar óculos.
cards.ex_t: Podes usar o multibanco ao lado da farmácia para levantar dinheiro.
cards.ex_trans: You can use the ATM next to the pharmacy to withdraw cash.

cards.ex_t: O vizinho veio ajudar-me a subir as compras até ao terceiro andar.
cards.ex_trans: The neighbour came to help me carry the shopping up to the third floor.

cards.note: morar is only to reside; viver also means to live (life).
cards.ex_t: Gosto de viver na Madeira, apesar das subidas.
cards.ex_trans: I like living in Madeira, despite the hills.

cards.note: Stem change: eu durmo.
cards.ex_t: Com este calor é difícil dormir sem ventoinha.
cards.ex_trans: In this heat it's hard to sleep without a fan.

cards.note: False friend: to wake up, not to accord or agree.
cards.ex_t: Amanhã tenho de acordar às seis para apanhar o primeiro autocarro.
cards.ex_trans: Tomorrow I have to wake up at six to catch the first bus.

cards.note: Presente: eu ouço.
cards.ex_t: Gosto de ouvir o mar da varanda ao fim da tarde.
cards.ex_trans: I like listening to the sea from the balcony in the late afternoon.

cards.ex_t: Costumo ler as notícias ao pequeno-almoço no café da esquina.
cards.ex_trans: I usually read the news over breakfast at the corner café.

cards.note: Irregular past participle: escrito.
cards.ex_t: Tenho de escrever um email ao senhorio por causa da humidade.
cards.ex_trans: I have to write an email to the landlord about the damp.

cards.ex_t: Vou enviar os documentos digitalizados para a AIMA ainda hoje.
cards.ex_trans: I'll send the scanned documents to AIMA later today.

cards.ex_t: Devo receber o novo cartão de residência este mês.
cards.ex_trans: I should receive the new residence card this month.

cards.note: mudar de casa = to move house.
cards.ex_t: Vamos mudar de casa para Câmara de Lobos em setembro.
cards.ex_trans: We're moving house to Câmara de Lobos in September.

cards.note: tentar + infinitive, no preposition.
cards.ex_t: Vou tentar apanhar o autocarro das oito e meia.
cards.ex_trans: I'm going to try to catch the half past eight bus.

cards.note: conseguir = manage to; poder = may/can. Presente: eu consigo.
cards.ex_t: Ao sábado é difícil conseguir mesa numa esplanada no centro.
cards.ex_trans: On Saturdays it's hard to get a table at a terrace café in the centre.

cards.note: Usually reflexive: esquecer-se de.
cards.ex_t: Não te podes esquecer do guarda-chuva; no Funchal chove sem avisar.
cards.ex_trans: You mustn't forget your umbrella; in Funchal it rains without warning.

cards.note: lembrar-se de = remember; lembrar alguém de = remind.
cards.ex_t: Podes lembrar-me de pagar a quota do condomínio no dia um?
cards.ex_trans: Can you remind me to pay the condo fee on the first?

cards.note: People and places; facts are saber.
cards.ex_t: Queres conhecer a levada do Caldeirão Verde no sábado?
cards.ex_trans: Do you want to check out the Caldeirão Verde levada on Saturday?

cards.ex_t: A banca do mercado começou a vender anonas esta semana.
cards.ex_trans: The market stall started selling custard apples this week.
